mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% in a 3-month window signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 100) causes inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins, suppressing S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 300 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates, suppressing equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth below 50,000 signals labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 50000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 700,000) drives robust corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 700000 (Rank IC < 0.03).
